ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark grey) vs 8% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in discrete clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark field across entire visible surface; high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (blobs) distributed sparsely across the central lobes with a dense concentration on the inferior left margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with a wide angle; depth is approximately 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire boundary; distinct high-amplitude peaks observed on the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral asymmetry; left lobe exhibits a broad convex curve while the right lobe shows an elongated, upward-sloping convex trajectory terminating in a sharp tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (3-10 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle attachment points, scattered throughout mid-lobe regions and densely clustered on the left outer tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant cluster of white, high-texture calcified matter on the lower-left fluke margin; irregular jagged morphology on right lobe tip likely indicating previous tissue loss.
